column2: [intro]
Sitting at the counter, I drink my melancholy,
The glasses pile up, echoing my misery,
Laughter rings out, but my heart loses its beat,
I search for inspiration, tonight, in defeat.
An evening at the bar, life a bit blue,
Scattered laughs and glasses anew,
In this dim-lit place, with glances that dart,
It's where I find my song, my art.
The hurried waiters, the loves cast aside,
The fleeting glances, in excess they hide,
But I dream of a happiness, so misplaced,
In this bar, where all's allowed, everything's "zigzagged."
An evening at the bar, the mind that toils,
The staggering drunks, life's uproarious spoils,
Within these anonymous walls, I seek a way,
A moment of true madness, a sweet refrain.
[ solo ]
An evening at the bar, the soul somewhat light,
The wine that flows, hope taking flight,
In these light conversations, my heart awakes,
I sing my sadness, my joy it makes.
[outro]
